ei.title: Hobbes: Mutual Fear, Not Affection, Binds Society
ei.subject: 10월_2024 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Hobbes: Mutual Fear, Not Affection, Binds Society

fullPassage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act morally in spite of his instinct to protect his existence in the state of nature. Hence, the only place where morality and moral liberty will begin to find an application begins in a place where a sovereign power, namely the state, emerges. Hobbes thus describes the state of nature as a circumstance in which man's life is "solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short". It means when people live without a general power to control them all, they are indeed in a state of war. In other words, Hobbes, who accepted that human beings are not social and political beings in the state of nature, believes that without the power human beings in the state of nature are "antisocial and rational based on their selfishness". Moreover, since society is not a natural phenomenon and there is no natural force bringing people together, what will bring them together as a society is not mutual affection according to Hobbes. It is, rather, mutual fear of men's present and future that assembles them, since the cause of fear is a common drive among people in the state of nature.

questions.passage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act morally in spite of his instinct to (A)[protect / abandon] his existence in the state of nature. Hence, the only place where morality and moral liberty will begin to find an application begins in a place where a sovereign power, namely the state, (B)[disappears / emerges]. Hobbes thus describes the state of nature as a circumstance in which man's life is "solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short". It means when people live without a general power to control them all, they are indeed in a state of (C)[war / peace]. In other words, Hobbes, who accepted that human beings are not social and political beings in the state of nature, believes that without the power human beings in the state of nature are "antisocial and rational based on their selfishness". Moreover, since society is not a natural phenomenon and there is no natural force bringing people together, what will bring them together as a society is not mutual affection according to Hobbes. It is, rather, mutual fear of men's present and future that assembles them, since the cause of fear is a common drive among people in the state of nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) protect=지키다 / abandon=버리다 (B) emerges=생겨나다 / disappears=사라지다 (C) war=전쟁 / peace=평화
det.analysis:
✅ ① protect — emerges — war: 인간은 자신의 존재를 '지키려는'(protect) 본능이 있고, 도덕은 국가라는 주권 권력이 '생겨나는'(emerges) 곳에서 시작되며, 통제 권력이 없으면 '전쟁'(war) 상태다 ←정답
❌ ② abandon: 존재를 '버리려는' 본능은 문맥과 반대
❌ ③ disappears/peace: 주권 권력이 '사라지고' 권력 없이 '평화'라는 것은 흐름과 정반대
❌ ④ abandon/disappears: 두 자리 모두 반대말
det.tip: protect(지키다)↔abandon(버리다), emerges(생겨나다)↔disappears(사라지다), war(전쟁)↔peace(평화)

questions.passage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act morally in spite of his instinct to protect his existence in the state of nature. Hence, the only place where morality and moral liberty will begin to find an application begins in a place where a sovereign power, namely the state, emerges. Hobbes thus (A)[denies / describes] the state of nature as a circumstance in which man's life is "solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short". It means when people live without a general power to (B)[control / obey] them all, they are indeed in a state of war. In other words, Hobbes, who accepted that human beings are not social and political beings in the state of nature, believes that without the power human beings in the state of nature are "antisocial and rational based on their selfishness". Moreover, since society is not a natural phenomenon and there is no natural force bringing people together, what will bring them together as a society is not mutual affection according to Hobbes. It is, rather, mutual fear of men's present and future that assembles them, since the cause of fear is a (C)[rare / common] drive among people in the state of nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) describes=묘사하다 / denies=부정하다 (B) control=통제하다 / obey=복종하다 (C) common=공통의 / rare=드문
det.analysis:
✅ ③ describes — control — common: 홉스는 자연 상태를 '묘사하고'(describes), 사람들을 '통제할'(control) 일반 권력이 없으면 전쟁 상태이며, 공포는 사람들 사이의 '공통된'(common) 동인이다 ←정답
❌ ① denies: 홉스가 자연 상태를 '부정한' 것이 아니라 묘사함
❌ ② obey/rare: 권력은 사람을 '복종시키는' 게 아니라 통제하며, 공포는 '드문' 게 아니라 공통됨
❌ ④ rare: 공포는 '드문'이 아니라 공통된 동인
det.tip: describes(묘사하다)↔denies(부정하다), control(통제하다)↔obey(복종하다), common(공통의)↔rare(드문)

questions.passage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act morally in spite of his instinct to protect his existence in the state of nature. Hence, the only place where morality and moral liberty will begin to find an application begins in a place where a (A)[sovereign / powerless] power, namely the state, emerges. Hobbes thus describes the state of nature as a circumstance in which man's life is "solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short". It means when people live without a general power to control them all, they are indeed in a state of war. In other words, Hobbes, who accepted that human beings are not social and political beings in the state of nature, believes that without the power human beings in the state of nature are "antisocial and rational based on their (B)[selfishness / generosity]". Moreover, since society is not a natural phenomenon and there is no natural force bringing people together, what will bring them together as a society is not mutual affection according to Hobbes. It is, rather, mutual fear of men's present and future that (C)[separates / assembles] them, since the cause of fear is a common drive among people in the state of nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) sovereign=주권을 가진 / powerless=무력한 (B) selfishness=이기심 / generosity=관대함 (C) assembles=모으다 / separates=떼어놓다
det.analysis:
✅ ② sovereign — selfishness — assembles: 도덕은 '주권을 가진'(sovereign) 권력이 생기는 곳에서 시작되고, 권력이 없으면 인간은 '이기심'(selfishness)에 기반해 반사회적이며, 상호 공포가 그들을 '모은다'(assembles) ←정답
❌ ① powerless: '무력한' 권력이 국가로 등장한다는 것은 모순
❌ ③ generosity/separates: 인간은 '관대함'이 아니라 이기심에 기반하고, 공포는 그들을 '떼어놓는' 게 아니라 모음
❌ ④ separates: 공포는 사람들을 '떼어놓는' 게 아니라 모음
det.tip: sovereign(주권을 가진)↔powerless(무력한), selfishness(이기심)↔generosity(관대함), assembles(모으다)↔separates(떼어놓다)

questions.passage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act ①<u>morally</u> in spite of his instinct to protect his existence in the state of nature. Hence, the only place where morality and moral liberty will begin to find an application begins in a place where a sovereign power, namely the state, emerges. Hobbes thus describes the state of nature as a circumstance in which man's life is "solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short". It means when people live without a general power to ②<u>control</u> them all, they are indeed in a state of ③<u>war</u>. In other words, Hobbes, who accepted that human beings are not social and political beings in the state of nature, believes that without the power human beings in the state of nature are "antisocial and rational based on their selfishness". Moreover, since society is not a natural phenomenon and there is no natural force bringing people together, what will bring them together as a society is not mutual affection according to Hobbes. It is, rather, mutual fear of men's present and future that assembles them, since the cause of fear is a ④<u>rare</u> drive among people in the state of nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① morally=도덕적으로 ② control=통제하다 ③ war=전쟁 ④ rare→common (부적절)
det.analysis:
✅ ① morally: 인간은 본능에도 불구하고 '도덕적으로' 행동할 수 있는 존재가 아니다 — 적절
✅ ② control: 사람들을 모두 '통제할' 일반 권력 — 적절
✅ ③ war: 통제 권력이 없으면 '전쟁' 상태 — 적절
❌ ④ rare: 원문은 common(공통의)인데 rare(드문)로 교체됨. 공포는 자연 상태의 사람들 사이에서 '공통된' 동인이므로 '드문'은 반대 ←정답
det.tip: the cause of fear is a common drive(공포는 공통된 동인). rare(드문)는 정반대

questions.passage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act morally in spite of his instinct to protect his ①<u>existence</u> in the state of nature. In other words, Hobbes, who accepted that human beings are not social and political beings in the state of nature, believes that without the power human beings in the state of nature are "antisocial and rational based on their ④<u>selfishness</u>". Moreover, since society is not a natural phenomenon and there is no natural force bringing people together, what will bring them together as a society is not mutual affection according to Hobbes. It is, rather, mutual fear of men's present and future that assembles them, since the cause of fear is a common drive among people in the state of nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① existence=존재 ② describes=묘사하다 ③ sociable→solitary (부적절) ④ selfishness=이기심
det.analysis:
✅ ① existence: 자신의 '존재'를 지키려는 본능 — 적절
✅ ② describes: 홉스는 자연 상태를 이렇게 '묘사한다' — 적절
❌ ③ sociable: 원문은 solitary(고독한)인데 sociable(사교적인)로 교체됨. 인간의 삶은 '고독하고 가난하고 험하다'는 부정적 나열이므로 '사교적인'은 반대 ←정답
✅ ④ selfishness: 그들의 '이기심'에 기반한 반사회적 존재 — 적절
det.tip: man's life is "solitary, poor, nasty..."(고독하고 가난하고 험하다). sociable(사교적인)은 정반대

det.korean: ① morally=도덕적으로 ② weak→sovereign (부적절) ③ war=전쟁 ④ common=공통의
det.analysis:
✅ ① morally: 본능에도 불구하고 '도덕적으로' 행동 — 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: affection=애정 / fear=공포 / hatred=증오 / habit=습관
det.analysis:
✅ ① affection: 사회를 묶는 것은 상호 '애정'(affection)이 아니라고 하고, 바로 뒤에서 '오히려 상호 공포'라고 대조하므로 빈칸은 애정이 정답 ←정답

❌ ③ hatred: 증오 — 사회를 묶을 것으로 기대되는 긍정적 유대가 아님
❌ ④ habit: 습관 — 문맥과 어울리지 않음
det.tip: not mutual ___ ... It is, rather, mutual fear → 애정(affection)이 아니라 공포

det.korean: assembles=모으다 / scatters=흩뜨리다 / divides=나누다 / gathers=모으다 / follows=따르다

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 state의 (A)와 (B)에서의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

✅ ④ (A) 인간의 자연적 조건을 전쟁 '상태(state)'로 묘사한다, (B) 주권 권력, 즉 '국가(state)'가 등장한다 ←정답

❌ ② (B) '계급'은 a sovereign power인 the state와 안 맞음

❌ ① habit: 습관 — 반복으로 익힌 것이라 타고난 성향과 다름

❌ ④ memory: 기억 — 과거 정보의 저장이라 무관
det.tip: a natural tendency without learning(배우지 않은 타고난 성향) = instinct(본능)

questions.passage: It is, rather, mutual fear of men's present and future that __________ (assemble) them, since the cause of fear is a common drive among people in the state of nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: assemble(모으다) → assembles(3인칭 단수). 관계대명사 that의 선행사가 mutual fear(단수)라 단수동사 assembles를 쓴다.
det.analysis: assemble을 assembles로 바꿉니다. 'that ___ them'에서 관계대명사 that이 가리키는 것은 앞의 mutual fear(상호 간의 두려움, 단수)예요. 주어가 단수라 동사도 3인칭 단수형 assembles를 써야 합니다.
det.tip: 선행사 mutual fear(단수) → 관계절 동사 assembles(단수)

questions.passage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act morally in spite of his instinct to protect his __________ (exist) in the state of nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: exist(존재하다) → existence(존재). 소유격(his) 뒤이자 동사 protect의 목적어 자리이므로 동사를 명사로 바꾼다.
det.analysis: exist를 명사 existence로 바꿉니다. 'to protect his ___'에서 빈칸은 소유격 his의 꾸밈을 받으면서 동사 protect의 목적어가 되는 자리예요. 이 자리에는 동사가 아니라 명사가 와야 하므로, 동사 exist에 -ence를 붙여 명사 existence(존재)로 만들어야 합니다.
det.tip: 동사→명사 파생: exist(존재하다) → existence(존재)
